Package org.unitseek.knitid.core.spi

Interface IdGeneratorFactory

All Known Implementing Classes:
BizIdGeneratorFactory, KsidIdGeneratorFactory, KsuidIdGeneratorFactory, TypeIdIdGeneratorFactory, UlidIdGeneratorFactory, Uuid7IdGeneratorFactory, Uuid8IdGeneratorFactory
public interface IdGeneratorFactory
Factory registered by an algorithm module. The central auto-configuration uses it to instantiate generators from knitid.generators.*.
